query:
SELECT tt.id, tt.appUserId, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt, au.name, au.email
FROM token_transactions tt
LEFT JOIN app_users au ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE tt.amount < 0
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
